snippet.title: BAKUDO -  Official Announcement Trailer ｜Boss Rush Demo out NOW!!
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2275860/
Play our Boss Rush DEMO: https://bit.ly/demo_bak_steam_yt

BAKUDO is a boss rush action game that fuses sci-fi school drama with high-intensity ball-sport combat.

You play as Yuria, a new student enrolling at a prestigious academy devoted to the sport of BAKUDO. As she faces off against powerful rivals in intense one-on-one battles, she uncovers a hidden secret—one that could threaten the fate of the entire world...
